PDF font assets

Noto Sans SC and Noto Sans Thai are distributed under the SIL Open Font License.
The accompanying OFL files contain their original copyright and license notices.

Sources (Google Fonts):
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosansthai

These TTF files are static regular-weight instances made with fontTools varLib.instancer:
NotoSansSC[wght].ttf -> wght=400
NotoSansThai[wdth,wght].ttf -> wght=400, wdth=100

Original SHA-256:
SC: a3041811a78c361b1de50f953c805e0244951c21c5bd412f7232ef0d899af0da
Thai: 5a1c559bb539583c8a1fd99d1c5b9491e5e14478c9cd2bd0970d5c3096cc9ef8

Fonts are fetched only when a PDF is requested and are subset-embedded in the PDF.
No report content is sent to a third-party conversion service.
